description: Source code for Windows-specific filesystem API wrapper functions for the lighttpd server, including UTF-8 path handling, directory creation, stat, and readlink functions.

methods.name: fs_win32_openUTF8
methods.description: Opens a file with a UTF-8 path on Windows.

methods.name: fs_win32_mkdirUTF8
methods.description: Creates a directory with a UTF-8 path on Windows.

methods.name: fs_win32_stati64UTF8
methods.description: Retrieves file status information for a UTF-8 path, handling trailing slashes.

methods.name: fs_win32_readlinkUTF8
methods.description: Reads the symbolic link target for a UTF-8 path on Windows.
